title: TasEnergy Insight
summary: Completed the current reporting milestone for a portfolio analytics project exploring Tasmania's June 2026 electricity market. Its Power BI dashboard analyses electricity demand, market prices, five-minute price spikes, daily and hourly patterns, demand versus price, negative-price intervals and periods requiring attention. The business scenario is fictional, not a client engagement. Completion refers to the reporting milestone; production deployment, live Power BI Service, automatic refresh and Fabric implementation are not claimed.
